free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed RNG seed so the symbolic generator is deterministic across runs

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: the target is reached on the first inserted Reshape; a small graph keeps the test fast and does not change the decision

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: small solve budget; the first Reshape insert succeeds well within it

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: default placeholder rank from random_model_gen; provides a tensor for the forward insert

free_parameters.name: forward_prob
free_parameters.why: force forward insertion so checked_requires is reached on the first node

free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: restrict the generator to Reshape so the target Reshape.requires is the first checked op
